description: OCR with the bundled English model. Runs when SPARKY_TEST_BIN holds tessdata/eng.traineddata.gz (npm run fetch-tools).

notes.text: A two-page letter-size PDF with one large word per page, drawn with a standard font pdf.js renders without system fonts.
The bundled model was read, then kept in the data folder for next time.
Every worker thread started while `fn` runs, so a test can check none is left behind.
Still stuck when the wait runs out: stop it so the rest of the suite can run.
